primary_mechanism_reference.scope: Historical mechanism evidence: group distribution depends on extensional stiffness, spacing/count and fastener slip; elastic distribution is distinct from wood limit states. Not substituted for2024NDS.

double_counting.conclusion: The same qualified scalar distribution effect must not be counted twice. Current3D model is not established as that qualified scalar NDS model. No factor waiver or complete pass follows.

criterion_scope: Cg applies to lateral connection Z. The local affine-pressure helper already includes Mode-I-like 4Ktheta but not the minimum of all yield modes. Independent steel reference remains separate. No criterion was deleted or favorably factored.
group_ownership_scope: Exact receiver signatures reproduce the evaluator trial partition only. Continuous wood and shared steel cross those partitions. Physical connection boundaries, load-wrench decomposition, load-aligned rows, stagger merging, EA and shear planes remain required.
geometry_status: All 158 footprint occurrences and all 54 short-7D occurrences are source-bound: 42 square-end conditional reductions, eight plywood applicability holds, four sloped-end definition holds. Actual signed loaded-edge/end and oblique-row classification remain unresolved. The top Table12.5.1D trial is newly relevant to 50.8 mm embedment; its main/side length and actual direction remain prerequisites, so no formal failure is declared.
minimal_remaining_checks: Map actual media and external wrench to justified NDS/TR12 main/side assignments and every yield mode; retain pressure sign reversals and free couples.
Establish complete connection ownership, load-aligned rows/staggering, gross/equivalent EA and applicable Cg without choosing favorable factors.
Classify signed edge/end/Cdelta and between-row geometry, then splitting, tear-out, net sections and subsets across overlapping groups.
Check delivered root/body/runout, axial washer/head/nut transfer and independent metal/fitting limit states.
Qualify screw/panel force-slip and resistance, plywood bond and actual thickness, finite-motion contact and floor support.
